scope: In-process native MCP, retained gopls. Untraced samples exclude setup, calibration, fixture preparation, metrics retrieval and correctness checks.

synthetic_trace.selection: For each scenario: initial calibration+one-call Go benchmark cohort excluded; final cohort calibration excluded. Last three of six operation regions retained.

cpu_profile.scope: Whole synthetic trace run including setup, calibration, final verification and runtime tracing; does not include child-process CPU.

before_metadata_filter.scope: Ten untraced observations per case before filtering unrelated leaf metadata. The old summary helper printed one start for the repository; its separate per-module continuity log correctly recorded three.

cpu_profile.scope: Whole run, including fixture setup, calibration and full verification outside operation timers.

notes: The synthetic trace and CPU profile precede the added fingerprint spans and metadata filter; their binary hash is retained.
The repository trace includes fingerprint spans and corrected process totals, before the metadata filter.
Final untraced observations include pathname filtering before selected leaf metadata. Full workspace diagnostic fingerprints are compared outside each repository operation timer.
Stage abort and the complete cold/hot repository tool matrix are outside this focused run.
